scenario: 要为「sub-200ms 的 inline 代码补全」搭训练数据与目标，先列出数据策略的支柱。
scenario_en: Building training data and objective for sub-200ms inline completion, first list the data-strategy pillars.
q: 代码生成数据策略的四大支柱是什么？
q_en: What are the four pillars of the code-generation data strategy?
why: 四支柱：语料构建（许可/去重/质量过滤）、fill-in-the-middle 预训练目标、推理期上下文信号组装、企业微调与隐私。数据侧决策直接决定生产行为——Copilot 用公共仓库训练就引发了法律审查，语料构建成了业务关键。
why_en: Corpus construction (license/dedup/quality), fill-in-the-middle pre-training, inference-time context signals, and enterprise fine-tuning with privacy — data decisions directly determine production behavior.
diagram:
flowchart TD D["数据策略"] --> C["1. 语料构建
许可/去重/质量"] D --> F["2. FIM 预训练"] D --> S["3. 上下文信号组装"] D --> E["4. 企业微调+隐私"]
options: 数据增强、超参搜索、早停、正则化——四种训练技巧
语料构建、fill-in-the-middle 预训练、推理期上下文组装、企业微调与隐私
分词、嵌入、注意力、解码——Transformer 四组件
标注、清洗、切分、导出——通用数据 ETL 四步
options_en: Data augmentation, hyperparameter search, early stopping, regularization — four training tricks.
Corpus construction, fill-in-the-middle pre-training, inference-time context assembly, enterprise fine-tuning with privacy.
Tokenization, embedding, attention, decoding — four Transformer components.
Label, clean, split, export — four generic data-ETL steps.
optionExplanations: 训练技巧是通用调参，不针对代码生成的语料/目标/上下文/隐私这几个关键决策。
对；这四支柱正是决定 inline 补全生产行为的数据侧关键决策，含法律敏感的语料构建。
Transformer 组件是模型结构，不是数据策略层面的决策。
通用 ETL 步骤太泛，抓不住 FIM 目标、上下文信号、企业隐私这些代码专属要点。
optionExplanations_en: Training tricks are generic tuning, not the code-gen-specific corpus/objective/context/privacy decisions.
Correct — these four pillars are the data-side decisions that determine inline-completion production behavior, including legally sensitive corpus construction.
Transformer components are model architecture, not data-strategy decisions.
Generic ETL steps are too broad and miss the FIM objective, context signals, and enterprise privacy specifics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过许可过滤、去重、质量过滤把原始代码整理成训练语料。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Corpus construction turns raw code into training data via license filtering, deduplication, and quality filtering.

scenario: 团队时间有限，要判断在数据策略里哪一步的投入回报最高。
scenario_en: With limited time, decide which data-strategy step has the highest leverage.
q: 为什么说语料构建是数据策略里杠杆最高的决策？
q_en: Why is corpus construction the highest-leverage data-strategy decision?
why: garbage in, garbage out：模型学到什么、有没有法律风险、会不会背下垃圾模式，都由喂进去的语料决定。许可过滤挡法律风险、去重防止背模板、质量过滤提信噪比——上游语料没搞对，下游再好的目标和上下文也补不回来。
why_en: Garbage in, garbage out — what the model learns, its legal risk, and whether it memorizes junk are all set by the corpus, which downstream objectives can't repair.
whenOtherWins: 如果语料已经是干净、合规、去重好的高质量数据，那杠杆点就转移到目标(FIM)和上下文组装上，语料再打磨收益递减。
options: 因为语料构建代码量最少，最省事
garbage in garbage out：语料决定模型学到什么、有无法律风险，上游错了下游补不回来
因为语料构建不需要 GPU，成本最低
因为语料一旦构建就永不改变，属于一次性工作
options_en: Because corpus construction needs the least code and is easiest.
Garbage in, garbage out — the corpus sets what the model learns and its legal risk, and upstream errors can't be fixed downstream.
Because corpus construction needs no GPU, so it's cheapest.
Because once built the corpus never changes — a one-time job.
optionExplanations: 省事与否不是杠杆高低的依据，杠杆在于它决定后续一切。
对；语料质量和合规性是模型行为的上游根因，选错语料下游目标/上下文都救不回来。
成本低不等于杠杆高，杠杆在于对最终行为的决定性影响。
语料会随语言分布、许可政策演进而更新，不是一次性不变的。
optionExplanations_en: Ease isn't the leverage criterion; leverage is that it determines everything downstream.
Correct — corpus quality and compliance are the upstream root cause of model behavior, unfixable downstream if chosen wrong.
Low cost isn't high leverage; leverage is its decisive impact on final behavior.
The corpus is updated as language distribution and license policy evolve — not a one-time fixed job.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入数据劣质，模型输出必然劣质；上游语料质量决定下游行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Garbage in, garbage out: poor input data yields poor model output, so upstream corpus quality governs downstream behavior.

scenario: 构建代码语料时要顺序跑几道过滤，每道挡住不同问题。
scenario_en: Building the code corpus runs several filters in sequence, each blocking a different problem.
q: 代码语料构建的三道过滤阶段是哪些？(多选)
q_en: Which are the three filtering stages of code corpus construction? (multiple)
why: 许可过滤（挡 copyleft 法律风险）、去重（防背模板样板码）、质量过滤（去自动生成/坏语法提信噪比）三道，各挡一类问题。「按 star 数排序保留热门仓库」不是这三道之一——热门≠合规或高质量。
why_en: License filtering (blocks copyleft legal risk), deduplication (prevents memorizing boilerplate), and quality filtering (removes junk to raise signal) — three stages each blocking a distinct problem.
options: 许可过滤：只留宽松许可、剔除 copyleft，挡法律风险
去重：删近似/完全重复，防止模型背样板码
质量过滤：去自动生成/坏语法/低注释比，提信噪比
按 GitHub star 数排序，只保留最热门的仓库
options_en: License filtering: keep permissive, drop copyleft, blocking legal risk.
Deduplication: remove near/exact duplicates so the model doesn't memorize boilerplate.
Quality filtering: drop auto-generated/broken-syntax/low-comment code to raise signal.
Sort by GitHub stars and keep only the most popular repos.
optionExplanations: 对；许可过滤先把 copyleft 挡在门外，消除下游许可传染的法律风险。
对；不去重模型会反复背样板码而学不到可泛化结构，是必要一道。
对；质量过滤剔除自动生成、坏语法等噪声，提升信噪比。
错；按 star 排序不等于合规或高质量，热门仓库照样可能是 copyleft 或含垃圾代码。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — license filtering blocks copyleft up front, removing downstream license-contamination legal risk.
Correct — without dedup the model memorizes boilerplate instead of generalizable structure — a necessary stage.
Correct — quality filtering removes auto-generated and broken-syntax noise, raising signal-to-noise.
Wrong — sorting by stars isn't compliance or quality; popular repos can still be copyleft or contain junk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 如 MIT/Apache 2.0/BSD，允许在专有代码中使用而不传染许可义务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A permissive license (MIT/Apache 2.0/BSD) allows use in proprietary code without imposing license obligations.

scenario: 模型输出可能与训练代码高度雷同，若训练里含 GPL/AGPL 代码，会给用户专有代码套上许可义务。
scenario_en: If training includes GPL/AGPL code, output resembling it could impose license obligations on users' proprietary code.
q: 许可过滤应该保留和剔除哪些许可证的代码？
q_en: Which license types should license filtering keep versus drop?
why: 保留宽松许可（MIT / Apache 2.0 / BSD）——可用于专有代码而不传染义务；剔除 copyleft（GPL / AGPL）——其衍生作品条款可能给用户专有代码套上开放义务。CodeWhisperer 再用 reference tracking 标记雷同建议作二次保险。
why_en: Keep permissive licenses (MIT/Apache 2.0/BSD) usable in proprietary code, and drop copyleft (GPL/AGPL) whose derivative terms can impose obligations on users' code.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型只在内部研究、输出绝不进入任何专有产品，copyleft 传染风险可控，可放宽以保留更多数据；一旦对外商用就必须严过滤。
options: 保留 GPL/AGPL，剔除 MIT/Apache，因为 copyleft 代码质量更高
全部保留，靠输出后再做许可检查兜底
保留宽松许可(MIT/Apache/BSD)，剔除 copyleft(GPL/AGPL)以避免许可传染
只按编程语言过滤，不看许可证
options_en: Keep GPL/AGPL and drop MIT/Apache, because copyleft code is higher quality.
Keep everything and rely on a post-output license check to catch issues.
Keep permissive (MIT/Apache/BSD), drop copyleft (GPL/AGPL) to avoid license contamination.
Filter only by programming language, ignoring licenses.
optionExplanations: 反了：正因 copyleft 会传染义务才要剔除 GPL/AGPL，许可类型与代码质量无必然关系。
全留只靠事后检查，训练数据里已埋下传染源，输出层补救成本高且不彻底。
对；留宽松、去 copyleft，从数据源头消除许可传染，是过滤的核心判据。
只按语言过滤完全无视法律风险，copyleft 代码照样进语料。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: GPL/AGPL are dropped precisely because copyleft contaminates; license type has no necessary tie to quality.
Keeping all with only post-hoc checks leaves the contamination source in training data, costly and incomplete to patch at output.
Correct — keep permissive, drop copyleft, removing license contamination at the source — the filter's core criterion.
Filtering only by language ignores legal risk entirely, letting copyleft code into the corpus.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衍生作品必须沿用同样开放条款的许可，可能传染到用户的专有代码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Copyleft (GPL/AGPL) requires derivatives to keep the same open terms, potentially contaminating users' proprietary code.

scenario: 只保留宽松许可后，语料规模缩水了约 40–60%。
scenario_en: After keeping only permissive licenses, the corpus shrinks by roughly 40–60%.
q: 「许可过滤砍掉 40–60% 语料」这个代价该怎么权衡？
q_en: How should you weigh the cost that license filtering cuts 40–60% of the corpus?
why: 缩水 40–60% 是显著代价，但它换来的是消除法律风险——对商用产品而言，许可传染可能让用户专有代码被套义务，风险不可接受。所以这笔数据换合规的交易通常值得，缺口用宽松许可内的更多数据、去重优化来补。
why_en: Losing 40–60% is significant, but it eliminates legal risk that's unacceptable for a commercial product, so the data-for-compliance trade is usually worth it.
tradeoff: 严过滤(数据少 40–60% 但零许可风险) vs 宽松保留(数据多但 copyleft 法律风险)
options: 缩水太多，应保留 copyleft 数据换取更大语料
40–60% 缩水换来消除许可传染的法律风险，对商用产品通常值得
缩水说明过滤有 bug，应关闭许可过滤
语料缩水会直接让模型延迟超过 200ms
options_en: Too much shrinkage — keep copyleft data for a bigger corpus.
The 40–60% loss buys elimination of license-contamination legal risk, usually worth it for a commercial product.
Shrinkage means the filter is buggy — turn license filtering off.
Corpus shrinkage directly pushes model latency past 200ms.
optionExplanations: 为多点数据保留 copyleft，等于把法律风险埋进商用产品，得不偿失。
对；数据换合规——40–60% 缩水消除许可传染风险，对要商用的代码模型通常划算。
缩水是过滤在正常起作用，不是 bug，关掉才会引回法律风险。
语料规模是训练侧的事，与推理延迟无直接因果，混淆了两个阶段。
optionExplanations_en: Keeping copyleft for more data buries legal risk in a commercial product — a bad trade.
Correct — data for compliance: the 40–60% loss removes contamination risk, usually worth it for a commercial code model.
Shrinkage is the filter working normally, not a bug; turning it off reintroduces legal risk.
Corpus size is a training concern with no direct causal link to inference latency — conflating two phases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 牺牲一部分训练数据量以换取法律合规，商用产品常见取舍。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The data-for-compliance tradeoff sacrifices some training data for legal compliance, common for commercial products.

scenario: 原始 GitHub 里有大量许可证头、样板 import、复制粘贴的工具函数在反复出现。
scenario_en: Raw GitHub has many repeated license headers, boilerplate imports, and copy-pasted utility functions.
q: 不做去重会给模型带来什么问题？
q_en: What problem does skipping deduplication cause for the model?
why: 重复样本被反复喂入，模型会把训练算力花在「背下」这些高频样板码上，而不是学习可泛化的代码结构。结果是过度记忆常见片段、泛化变差。去重让模型把容量用在多样、真正有信息量的代码上。
why_en: Repeated samples make the model memorize high-frequency boilerplate instead of learning generalizable structure, hurting generalization.
options: 模型会训练得更快，因为重复样本容易拟合
模型把容量花在背下高频样板码上，学不到可泛化结构，泛化变差
没有影响，重复样本会被优化器自动忽略
只影响存储成本，不影响模型质量
options_en: The model trains faster because duplicates are easy to fit.
The model spends capacity memorizing high-frequency boilerplate instead of generalizable structure, hurting generalization.
No effect — the optimizer auto-ignores duplicate samples.
It only affects storage cost, not model quality.
optionExplanations: 快速拟合重复样本恰恰是坏事——那是在记忆而非泛化。
对；高频重复让模型偏向记忆样板码，挤占学习可泛化结构的容量，泛化下降。
优化器不会自动忽略重复，重复会真实地放大对样板码的记忆。
不只是存储：重复直接扭曲学习目标、损害泛化，是质量问题。
optionExplanations_en: Quickly fitting duplicates is the bad outcome — that's memorization, not generalization.
Correct — high-frequency repeats bias the model to memorize boilerplate, crowding out capacity for generalizable structure.
The optimizer doesn't auto-ignore duplicates; they genuinely amplify memorization of boilerplate.
It's not just storage: duplicates distort the learning objective and harm generalization — a quality problem.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除语料中近似或完全重复的样本，防止模型记忆而非泛化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Deduplication removes near or exact duplicate samples so the model generalizes instead of memorizing.

scenario: 很多重复只是改了变量名或空白，逐字比对抓不到这类近似重复。
scenario_en: Many duplicates differ only in variable names or whitespace, which exact matching misses.
q: 怎么高效检测「只差变量名/空白」的近似重复？
q_en: How do you efficiently detect near-duplicates differing only in variable names/whitespace?
why: 用 MinHash 做概率型近似重复检测，在文件级和函数级同时跑，能抓到只差变量名或空白的近似重复。逐字精确匹配抓不到这类，而全量两两比对代价爆炸；MinHash 用哈希草图近似 Jaccard 相似度，可扩展地找近似对。
why_en: MinHash probabilistic near-duplicate detection at file and function level catches near-dups differing only in variable names or whitespace, which exact matching misses and full pairwise comparison can't scale to.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需删完全字节相同的重复，直接对文件做哈希精确匹配更简单更快，不必上 MinHash 的近似方案。
options: 只对整文件做 SHA 精确哈希匹配
用 MinHash 概率近似重复检测，在文件级+函数级抓近似重复
人工逐个仓库审阅去重
按文件大小分桶，同桶即判为重复
options_en: Exact SHA hashing on whole files only.
MinHash probabilistic near-duplicate detection at file and function level.
Manually review each repo to deduplicate.
Bucket files by size and treat same-bucket as duplicates.
optionExplanations: 整文件精确哈希只抓字节完全相同的，改个变量名就漏掉，抓不到近似重复。
对；MinHash 用哈希草图近似 Jaccard 相似度，可扩展地抓到只差变量名/空白的近似对，文件+函数两级更细。
人工审阅在 GitHub 规模上完全不可行，也不可复现。
文件大小相同远不代表内容重复，这个判据会大量误判。
optionExplanations_en: Whole-file exact hashing catches only byte-identical files and misses near-dups once a variable is renamed.
Correct — MinHash approximates Jaccard similarity with hash sketches to scalably catch near-dups differing in names/whitespace, at both file and function level.
Manual review is infeasible and non-reproducible at GitHub scale.
Equal file size doesn't mean duplicate content; this criterion misfires massively.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希草图近似估计集合间 Jaccard 相似度的算法，可扩展地找近似重复。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MinHash uses hash sketches to approximate Jaccard similarity between sets, scalably finding near-duplicates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个集合交集大小除以并集大小，衡量重叠程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Jaccard similarity is the intersection size over union size of two sets, measuring overlap.

scenario: 质量过滤阶段要剔除会污染信号的代码。
scenario_en: The quality-filtering stage removes code that pollutes the signal.
q: 质量过滤应剔除哪些类型的代码？(多选)
q_en: Which kinds of code should quality filtering remove? (multiple)
why: 剔除自动生成代码（protobuf 桩、压缩后的 minified JS，模式重复无信息）、语法无效代码（坏代码教出坏输出）、注释-代码比过低的、以及 vendored 依赖（第三方拷进来的库，非本项目逻辑）。手写的核心业务逻辑正是要保留的，不该剔除。
why_en: Remove auto-generated code (protobuf stubs, minified JS), syntax-invalid code, low comment-to-code ratio, and vendored dependencies, while keeping hand-written core logic.
options: 自动生成代码：protobuf 桩、minified JS 等重复无信息的
语法无效代码：坏代码会教出坏输出
vendored 依赖：拷进仓库的第三方库，非本项目逻辑
手写的核心业务逻辑：项目最有价值的代码
options_en: Auto-generated code: protobuf stubs, minified JS, repetitive and low-information.
Syntax-invalid code: broken code teaches broken output.
Vendored dependencies: third-party libs copied into the repo, not the project's logic.
Hand-written core business logic: the project's most valuable code.
optionExplanations: 对；自动生成的桩/压缩码模式重复、无泛化价值，留着只会稀释信号。
对；语法坏的代码会让模型学到坏结构，必须剔除。
对；vendored 第三方库不是本项目逻辑，且常与其他仓库重复，该去。
错；手写核心逻辑正是要学的信号，剔除它等于扔掉最有价值的数据。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — auto-generated stubs/minified code are repetitive with no generalization value and only dilute signal.
Correct — syntactically broken code teaches broken structure and must be removed.
Correct — vendored third-party libs aren't project logic and often duplicate other repos, so drop them.
Wrong — hand-written core logic is exactly the signal to learn; removing it throws away the most valuable data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把第三方库源码直接拷进仓库的做法，属外部代码非本项目逻辑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Vendored dependencies are third-party library sources copied into a repo — external code, not the project's own logic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 去掉空白和短变量名后的 JavaScript，机器生成、几乎无可读结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Minified JS is JavaScript stripped of whitespace and given short names — machine-produced with almost no readable structure.

scenario: 质量过滤开得很激进，Rust、Kotlin 这类小众语言的样本本来就少，过滤后所剩无几。
scenario_en: Aggressive quality filtering leaves rare languages like Rust and Kotlin, already sparse, with almost nothing.
q: 过度激进的过滤对小众语言有什么风险，怎么防？
q_en: What's the risk of over-aggressive filtering for rare languages, and how to guard?
why: 过滤越狠、信噪比越高，但会误伤本就稀少的小众语言（Rust/Kotlin），把它们过滤到欠训练、补全质量差。防法：每道过滤阶段后监控各语言的语料规模，发现某语言被砍太多就放宽或补数据，别一刀切。
why_en: Aggressive filtering raises signal but over-removes already-sparse rare languages (Rust/Kotlin) into undertraining, so monitor per-language corpus size after each stage.
tradeoff: 激进过滤(信噪比高但误伤小众语言) vs 温和过滤(保留长尾但噪声多)
options: 没有风险，语言越少模型越专注
小众语言被过滤到欠训练、补全差；应在每阶段后监控各语言语料规模
只会影响热门语言，小众语言不受影响
过滤越狠一定越好，不需要任何监控
options_en: No risk — fewer languages make the model more focused.
Rare languages get filtered into undertraining with poor completions; monitor per-language corpus size after each stage.
Only popular languages are affected; rare ones are unaffected.
Harder filtering is always better and needs no monitoring.
optionExplanations: 把小众语言过滤没了不是「专注」，是丢失长尾覆盖、这些语言用户体验崩掉。
对；激进过滤会误伤本就稀少的语言，逐阶段监控各语言规模才能及时放宽止损。
恰恰相反：小众语言基数小，最容易被激进过滤砍到欠训练。
越狠越好忽视了误伤长尾，不监控就发现不了某语言已被砍空。
optionExplanations_en: Filtering rare languages away isn't 'focus'; it's losing long-tail coverage and wrecking those users' experience.
Correct — aggressive filtering harms already-sparse languages, so per-stage per-language monitoring lets you loosen in time.
Opposite: rare languages have small counts and are most easily filtered into undertraining.
'Harder is always better' ignores long-tail harm; without monitoring you won't notice a language emptied out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某类数据(如小众语言)样本太少，模型在其上表现差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Undertrained means too few samples of a category (e.g. a rare language), so the model performs poorly on it.

scenario: 标准 left-to-right 因果语言模型只根据前文预测下一个 token。
scenario_en: A standard left-to-right causal LM predicts the next token only from preceding tokens.
q: 标准因果 LM 用在 inline 代码补全上有什么局限？
q_en: What limits a standard causal LM for inline code completion?
why: 因果 LM 只看前文预测下一个 token，在文件末尾续写没问题；但真实编辑大多发生在文件中间——光标在函数内部时，模型需要同时看前缀（上方）和后缀（下方）才能给出与已有结构协调的补全。只看前文会和光标下方的代码冲突。
why_en: A causal LM predicts from preceding tokens only, fine at end of file, but most editing is mid-file where the model needs both the prefix above and suffix below the cursor.
options: 它只能生成注释，不能生成代码
它只看前文预测，在文件中间补全时用不到光标下方的后缀，易与已有结构冲突
它推理太慢，无法满足 200ms
它只支持英文，不支持代码
options_en: It can only generate comments, not code.
It predicts only from preceding text, so mid-file it can't use the suffix below the cursor and conflicts with existing structure.
It's too slow to meet 200ms.
It only supports English, not code.
optionExplanations: 因果 LM 当然能生成代码，局限不在此。
对；只看前缀让它在文件中间「看不见下方」，补全常和光标后的代码结构冲突。
速度是服务侧问题，与「只看前文」的建模局限无关。
代码模型就是在代码上训练的，语言支持不是这里的局限。
optionExplanations_en: A causal LM certainly generates code; that's not the limit.
Correct — seeing only the prefix makes it 'blind below' mid-file, so completions conflict with code after the cursor.
Speed is a serving concern, unrelated to the 'preceding-only' modeling limit.
Code models are trained on code; language support isn't the limit here.

termDefinitions.term: causal LM / 因果语言模型
termDefinitions.meaning: left-to-right 逐 token 预测，仅以前文为条件，看不到后文。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A causal LM predicts left-to-right token by token, conditioned only on preceding text, blind to what follows.

termDefinitions.term: prefix / suffix / 前缀 / 后缀
termDefinitions.meaning: 光标上方已有代码为前缀、下方已有代码为后缀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefix is the code above the cursor and suffix the code below it.

scenario: 光标常停在函数内部，补全必须同时兼顾上方前缀和下方后缀，才不会和已有代码打架。
scenario_en: The cursor often sits inside a function, and completions must fit both the prefix above and suffix below.
q: 要让模型在文件中间也能补出协调的代码，该用什么预训练目标？
q_en: What pre-training objective lets the model complete coherently mid-file?
why: fill-in-the-middle（FIM）：训练时随机抽出一段连续 span，把前缀+后缀给模型、让它预测中间。这样模型学会同时以上下文两侧为条件，正是 inline 补全在文件中间不与后文冲突的关键。没有 FIM，模型利用不了光标下方的代码。
why_en: Fill-in-the-middle (FIM): randomly extract a contiguous span, give the model prefix + suffix, and have it predict the middle, teaching it to condition on both sides.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标只是从空文件顺序生成新代码（没有下方后缀），标准因果 LM 就够；FIM 的价值在于有后缀可依赖的中间补全。
options: 继续用标准因果 LM，只是把上下文窗口调大
fill-in-the-middle：抽出中间 span，给前缀+后缀让模型预测中间
masked LM：随机遮 15% token 让模型还原
只训练文档生成目标，让模型学会总结
options_en: Keep the standard causal LM, just enlarge the context window.
Fill-in-the-middle: extract a middle span, give prefix + suffix, and predict the middle.
Masked LM: randomly mask 15% of tokens to reconstruct.
Train only a documentation objective so the model learns to summarize.
optionExplanations: 加大窗口不改变「只看前文」的本质，中间补全还是用不上后缀。
对；FIM 用「前缀+后缀→预测中间」的目标，直接教会模型双向条件化，适配文件中间补全。
masked LM 是随机遮 token 的双向理解目标，不针对「连续中间 span」的生成式补全。
文档目标学的是总结，不解决中间代码补全的双向条件问题。
optionExplanations_en: A bigger window doesn't change 'preceding-only'; mid-file completion still can't use the suffix.
Correct — FIM's prefix+suffix→predict-middle objective directly teaches bidirectional conditioning for mid-file completion.
Masked LM randomly masks tokens for bidirectional understanding, not generative completion of a contiguous middle span.
A doc objective learns summarization and doesn't solve mid-file completion's two-sided conditioning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预训练目标：给模型前缀和后缀，让它预测被抽走的中间片段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIM (Fill-In-the-Middle) is a pre-training objective giving the model prefix and suffix to predict the removed middle span.

scenario: 实现 FIM 时要选一种把前缀、后缀、中间拼进序列的输入格式。
scenario_en: Implementing FIM, you choose how to lay out prefix, suffix, and middle in the input sequence.
q: FIM 的 PSM 和 SPM 两种输入格式有什么区别？
q_en: How do FIM's PSM and SPM input formats differ?
why: PSM = [PREFIX] 前缀 [SUFFIX] 后缀 [MIDDLE] → 生成中间，是最广泛采用的排布；SPM 把后缀排在前缀之前，强迫模型更早地关注后缀。两者只是拼接顺序不同，目标都是让模型以两侧为条件补中间。
why_en: PSM lays out prefix then suffix then middle (most widely adopted), while SPM puts the suffix before the prefix to force the model to attend to the suffix earlier.
tradeoff: PSM(最常用、前缀在前) vs SPM(后缀前置、更早关注后缀)
options: PSM 用于训练、SPM 用于推理，二者阶段不同
PSM 前缀在前(最常用)，SPM 后缀前置以强迫更早关注后缀，均为拼接顺序不同
PSM 只给前缀、SPM 只给后缀
PSM 是因果 LM、SPM 是 masked LM
options_en: PSM is for training and SPM for inference — different phases.
PSM puts prefix first (most common); SPM puts suffix first to force earlier attention to it — both just different orderings.
PSM gives only the prefix and SPM only the suffix.
PSM is a causal LM and SPM is a masked LM.
optionExplanations: 两者都是 FIM 的输入格式，与训练/推理阶段无关，这个划分是错的。
对；核心区别只是前缀/后缀的排布顺序，SPM 前置后缀让模型更早看到下方代码。
PSM 和 SPM 都同时给前缀和后缀，只是顺序不同，不是各给一半。
两者都是 FIM 生成式目标下的排布，与 masked LM 无关。
optionExplanations_en: Both are FIM input formats, unrelated to training/inference phases — the split is wrong.
Correct — the core difference is prefix/suffix ordering; SPM fronts the suffix so the model sees code below earlier.
Both PSM and SPM give prefix and suffix together, just in different order — not half each.
Both are layouts under FIM's generative objective, unrelated to masked LM.

termDefinitions.meaning: FIM 输入格式：[PREFIX]前缀[SUFFIX]后缀[MIDDLE]→生成中间，最广泛采用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSM (Prefix-Suffix-Middle) is a FIM layout: prefix, then suffix, then generate the middle — the most widely adopted.

termDefinitions.meaning: FIM 输入格式：把后缀排在前缀之前，强迫模型更早关注后缀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SPM (Suffix-Prefix-Middle) is a FIM layout putting the suffix before the prefix to force earlier attention to the suffix.

scenario: 决定训练里多大比例的样本用 FIM 目标、多少保留标准因果 LM。
scenario_en: Deciding what fraction of training uses the FIM objective versus keeping causal LM.
q: 填空：FIM 应用比例及保留因果 LM 的原因。
q_en: Fill in the blanks: the FIM application ratio and why keep causal LM.
text: 对约 {{50–90%}} 的样本应用 FIM 目标，其余保留标准 {{因果 LM(causal LM)}}，以保住从零(新文件、没有后缀)顺序生成的能力。比例是经验区间，不是公式。
text_en: Apply FIM to about {{50–90%}} of examples and keep the rest as standard {{causal LM}} to preserve from-scratch generation (new files with no suffix). The ratio is an empirical range, not a formula.
why: 50–90% 是经验配比：大部分样本走 FIM 练中间补全，但要留一部分因果 LM，否则模型会丢掉「空文件从头顺序写」的能力（新文件根本没有后缀可依赖）。混合训练兼顾两种真实场景。
why_en: 50–90% is empirical: most examples train FIM for mid-file completion, but keeping some causal LM preserves from-scratch generation for new files with no suffix.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在空文件或文件末尾顺序生成代码，没有后缀可依赖，靠因果 LM 能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: From-scratch generation writes code sequentially in an empty file or at file end with no suffix, relying on causal-LM ability.

scenario: 一个纯因果 LM 训练的模型，inline 建议经常和光标下方已有的代码打架（重复声明、结构冲突）。
scenario_en: A causal-LM-only model's inline suggestions keep conflicting with code already below the cursor (redundant declarations, structure clashes).
q: 补全总与光标下方代码冲突，最直接的修法是什么？
q_en: Completions keep conflicting with code below the cursor — the most direct fix?
why: 根因是模型看不到后缀。最直接的修法是用 FIM 预训练，让模型同时以前缀和后缀为条件——它就能看见光标下方已有的代码，补出与之协调、不重复不冲突的中间片段。加大窗口、换更大模型都绕过了根因。
why_en: The root cause is the model can't see the suffix, so apply FIM pre-training to condition on both prefix and suffix, making completions coherent with code below the cursor.
options: 加大上下文窗口，让模型看到更多前文
换一个参数更大的模型
用 FIM 预训练，让模型同时以前缀和后缀为条件，看见光标下方代码
在推理时把光标下方代码删掉再补全
options_en: Enlarge the context window to see more preceding text.
Switch to a model with more parameters.
Apply FIM pre-training so the model conditions on both prefix and suffix, seeing code below the cursor.
Delete the code below the cursor at inference, then complete.
optionExplanations: 加大窗口给的还是更多前文，模型仍看不到后缀，冲突照旧。
更大模型不改变「只看前文」的建模缺陷，钱花了病没治。
对；FIM 让模型双向条件化，直接看见并协调光标下方代码，是对根因的修复。
删掉下方代码是破坏用户文件，且丢了本该利用的后缀信息，荒谬。
optionExplanations_en: A bigger window still gives more preceding text; the model still can't see the suffix and conflicts persist.
A bigger model doesn't fix the 'preceding-only' modeling flaw — money spent, disease untreated.
Correct — FIM makes the model condition on both sides, directly seeing and reconciling code below the cursor — the root-cause fix.
Deleting code below vandalizes the user's file and discards the very suffix you should use — absurd.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成时同时以前缀和后缀为条件，使补全与两侧协调。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bidirectional conditioning generates while conditioned on both prefix and suffix so completions fit both sides.

scenario: 即便 FIM 模型很好，推理时若没喂对上下文照样补不准，IDE 要组装几类信号。
scenario_en: Even a good FIM model fails without the right inference-time context; the IDE assembles several signal categories.
q: IDE 在发起补全请求前会组装哪几类上下文信号？(多选)
q_en: Which context signal categories does the IDE assemble before a completion request? (multiple)
why: 四类：当前文件上下文（光标处切成前缀/后缀，最小可用输入）、开着的标签页（其他文件片段，按最近使用或 Jaccard 相似度排序前置）、光标位置元数据（行号/缩进/作用域，校准补全粒度）、仓库级上下文（import 图、跨模块签名、类型定义，最贵）。
why_en: File context (prefix/suffix around cursor), open tabs (ranked by recency or Jaccard similarity), cursor-position metadata (line/indent/scope), and repo-level context (import graphs, signatures, types).
options: 当前文件上下文：光标处切成前缀/后缀(最小可用输入)
开着的标签页片段：按最近使用或 Jaccard 相似度排序前置
仓库级上下文：import 图、跨模块签名、类型定义(最贵)
用户的鼠标移动轨迹和点击热力图
options_en: Current file context: split into prefix/suffix at the cursor (minimum viable input).
Open-tab snippets: ranked by recency or Jaccard similarity and prepended.
Repo-level context: import graphs, cross-module signatures, type definitions (most expensive).
The user's mouse-movement trails and click heatmaps.
optionExplanations: 对；当前文件切前缀/后缀是最小可用输入，任何补全的基础。
对；其他开着的文件常含相关代码，按最近/相似度排序前置能补充跨文件线索。
对；import 图和跨模块签名给跨文件一致性，但收集成本最高。
错；鼠标轨迹/点击热力图与代码语义无关，不是补全需要的上下文信号。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the current file's prefix/suffix is the minimum viable input, the basis of any completion.
Correct — other open files often hold related code, and ranking by recency/similarity adds cross-file cues.
Correct — import graphs and cross-module signatures give cross-file coherence but cost the most to collect.
Wrong — mouse trails/click heatmaps are unrelated to code semantics and aren't needed context signals.

termDefinitions.meaning: IDE 在补全前收集的多类线索：文件、开着的标签页、光标元数据、仓库级信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Context signals are the cues the IDE gathers before completion: file, open tabs, cursor metadata, and repo-level info.

scenario: 开着的其他文件里有很多代码，但上下文窗口有限，只能挑最相关的片段前置进 prompt。
scenario_en: Other open files hold lots of code, but the context window is limited, so you prepend only the most relevant snippets.
q: 从开着的标签页里挑片段进 prompt，该按什么排序？
q_en: How should you rank open-tab snippets to prepend to the prompt?
why: 按最近使用（recency）或与当前代码的 Jaccard 相似度排序，取最相关的片段前置。开发者刚看过的文件、和当前代码 token 重叠高的文件，最可能含相关定义。随便全塞会挤爆窗口、增加 prefill，反而稀释注意力。
why_en: Rank by recency or Jaccard similarity to the current code and prepend the most relevant, since recently viewed or high-overlap files most likely hold relevant definitions.
whenOtherWins: 如果仓库有可靠的 import 依赖图，用依赖关系直接定位相关文件比启发式的最近/相似排序更精确，此时该优先用仓库级信号。
options: 按文件名字母顺序
按最近使用(recency)或与当前代码的 Jaccard 相似度排序，取最相关的前置
按文件大小从大到小
把所有开着的标签页原封不动全塞进 prompt
options_en: Alphabetically by filename.
By recency or Jaccard similarity to the current code, prepending the most relevant.
By file size, largest first.
Cram every open tab wholesale into the prompt.
optionExplanations: 字母序与相关性无关，纯随机地占用宝贵窗口。
对；最近看过或 token 重叠高的文件最可能含相关定义，按此排序前置最有信息量。
文件大小不代表相关性，大文件塞进来多半是噪声。
全塞会撑爆上下文窗口、抬高 prefill 延迟，还稀释模型注意力。
optionExplanations_en: Alphabetical has nothing to do with relevance, wasting the precious window randomly.
Correct — recently viewed or high-overlap files most likely hold relevant definitions, so rank and prepend by that.
File size doesn't imply relevance; big files are mostly noise.
Cramming everything overflows the window, raises prefill latency, and dilutes attention.

termDefinitions.term: recency ranking / 最近使用排序
termDefinitions.meaning: 越近被查看/编辑的文件越可能相关，据此优先纳入上下文。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recency ranking prioritizes files viewed or edited most recently as most likely relevant for context.

scenario: 同一个模型，有时该补一整个多行块，有时只该补半个表达式，取决于光标在哪。
scenario_en: The same model should sometimes complete a whole multi-line block, sometimes half an expression, depending on cursor position.
q: 光标位置元数据（行号、缩进、作用域）在补全里起什么作用？
q_en: What role does cursor-position metadata (line, indent, scope) play in completion?
why: 它校准补全粒度：光标在模块作用域、空行起头，往往该补多行块；光标卡在表达式中间，就该补短短一截 inline。缩进和作用域告诉模型「现在该给多大一口」，避免在半句里硬塞一整个函数。
why_en: It calibrates completion granularity — module scope suggests a multi-line block, mid-expression suggests a short inline snippet — so the model gives the right-sized suggestion.
options: 决定用哪种编程语言的语法高亮
校准补全粒度：模块作用域→多行块，表达式中间→短 inline
决定请求走哪台推理服务器
没有实际作用，只是日志字段
options_en: Decides which language's syntax highlighting to use.
Calibrates completion granularity: module scope → multi-line block, mid-expression → short inline.
Decides which inference server the request goes to.
No real effect — just a logging field.
optionExplanations: 语法高亮是编辑器渲染，与模型补全粒度无关。
对；缩进和作用域告诉模型该补多大一口，避免在半个表达式里塞整段代码。
路由是服务侧的事，光标元数据是给模型的语义线索，不管路由。
它是实实在在影响补全形态的语义信号，不是无用日志。
optionExplanations_en: Syntax highlighting is editor rendering, unrelated to model completion granularity.
Correct — indent and scope tell the model how big a bite to complete, avoiding stuffing a whole block into half an expression.
Routing is a serving concern; cursor metadata is a semantic cue for the model, not routing.
It's a real semantic signal shaping the completion's form, not a useless log.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据光标所在作用域调整补全长度：整块 vs 短 inline。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Granularity calibration adjusts completion length by the cursor's scope: a whole block versus a short inline snippet.

scenario: 仓库相关代码远超上下文窗口容量，全塞进不去、乱塞又稀释注意力还增 prefill。
scenario_en: Relevant repo code far exceeds the context window; you can't include it all and cramming dilutes attention while raising prefill.
q: 上下文窗口装不下所有相关代码时，该怎么取舍纳入哪些？
q_en: When the window can't fit all relevant code, how do you choose what to include?
why: 用 Hierarchical Context Pruning（HCP）：在保持拓扑依赖（谁依赖谁、类型/import 链完整）的前提下，剪掉低相关度的代码，在「上下文丰富度 vs 输入长度」之间优化。既保住关键依赖，又不撑爆窗口、不无谓抬高 prefill。
why_en: Use Hierarchical Context Pruning (HCP): keep topological dependencies intact while pruning low-relevance code, optimizing richness versus input length.
whenOtherWins: 如果相关代码本就远小于窗口，直接全放即可，HCP 的剪枝开销没必要；它只在上下文超预算时才划算。
options: 直接截断到窗口大小，砍掉超出的部分不管依赖
Hierarchical Context Pruning：保拓扑依赖、剪低相关代码，优化丰富度 vs 长度
把窗口无限加大，硬塞所有相关代码
只放当前文件，其余仓库上下文一律不放
options_en: Truncate to the window size, cutting the overflow regardless of dependencies.
Hierarchical Context Pruning: keep topological dependencies, prune low-relevance code, optimize richness vs length.
Grow the window infinitely and force in all relevant code.
Include only the current file and never any other repo context.
optionExplanations: 无脑截断可能砍断关键依赖（缺了某个类型定义），补全直接失准。
对；HCP 保住拓扑依赖同时剪低相关码，在丰富度与长度间取平衡，正是窗口不够时的解法。
无限加大窗口会让 prefill 二次方级暴涨、击穿 200ms，不现实。
只放当前文件丢掉了跨文件依赖，跨模块补全会不一致。
optionExplanations_en: Blind truncation can sever key dependencies (a missing type definition), directly breaking completion accuracy.
Correct — HCP keeps topological dependencies while pruning low-relevance code, balancing richness and length exactly when the window is short.
Infinitely growing the window makes prefill blow up quadratically and break 200ms — impractical.
Only the current file drops cross-file dependencies, so cross-module completions become inconsistent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层上下文剪枝：保持拓扑依赖、剪掉低相关代码，平衡上下文丰富度与输入长度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HCP (Hierarchical Context Pruning) keeps topological dependencies while pruning low-relevance code to balance context richness against input length.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代码间的依赖顺序(类型、import、调用链)，剪枝时须保持不断裂。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Topological dependencies are the ordering of code dependencies (types, imports, call chains) that pruning must keep intact.

scenario: 多喂上下文能提升补全质量，但 inline 有 sub-200ms 硬预算。
scenario_en: More context improves completion quality, but inline has a hard sub-200ms budget.
q: 「多给上下文」为什么会威胁到 sub-200ms 预算？
q_en: Why does 'more context' threaten the sub-200ms budget?
why: 上下文越长，prefill 计算越多（标准注意力对序列长度是二次方级），TTFT 随之上升。多喂上下文提质量，但会吃掉推理预算、逼近甚至击穿 200ms。所以要量化：每多一段上下文换来的质量增益，是否值这点 prefill 延迟。
why_en: Longer context means more prefill compute (quadratic in length), raising TTFT, so more context improves quality but eats the inference budget toward or past 200ms.
tradeoff: 多上下文(质量更高但 prefill 更慢) vs 少上下文(快但可能缺关键依赖)
options: 上下文越长模型越快，因为它有更多信息可抄
上下文越长 prefill 计算越多、TTFT 上升，可能吃穿 200ms 预算
上下文长度只影响显存，不影响延迟
上下文和延迟无关，200ms 只由网络决定
options_en: Longer context makes the model faster because it has more to copy.
Longer context means more prefill compute and higher TTFT, potentially blowing the 200ms budget.
Context length only affects memory, not latency.
Context is unrelated to latency; 200ms is set solely by the network.
optionExplanations: 更长上下文只会更慢，不会更快，信息多不等于计算少。
对；prefill 随上下文长度(近二次方)增长，TTFT 抬高，多喂上下文可能击穿 200ms。
上下文长度既吃显存也吃 prefill 时间，说「不影响延迟」是错的。
网络只是预算一部分，prefill 才是随上下文变化的大头，二者都影响延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Longer context only slows things; more information doesn't mean less compute.
Correct — prefill grows (near-quadratically) with context length, raising TTFT, so more context can break 200ms.
Context length costs both memory and prefill time, so 'no latency effect' is wrong.
Network is only part of the budget; prefill is the part that scales with context, and both affect latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对输入上下文一次性算 K/V 的计算量，随长度近二次方增长，决定 TTFT。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefill cost is computing K/V for the input context, growing near-quadratically with length and setting TTFT.

scenario: 某企业有大量专有框架、内部 API、编码规范，通用基座模型不懂这些，补全常不贴合。
scenario_en: An enterprise has proprietary frameworks, internal APIs, and conventions the general base model doesn't know, so completions don't fit.
q: 怎么让模型理解企业专有代码，同时守住 FIM 补全能力？
q_en: How do you make the model understand a company's proprietary code while keeping FIM completion?
why: 在企业自己的代码库上、用同样的 FIM 目标微调基座 checkpoint。基座（公共宽松语料）是通用的，微调让它学会企业的框架、内部 API 和规范，同时沿用 FIM 保留中间补全能力。关键约束：微调必须在客户安全边界内（VPC 或 air-gapped）跑。
why_en: Fine-tune the base checkpoint on the company's codebase with the same FIM objective, teaching it the firm's frameworks and conventions while preserving mid-file completion.
whenOtherWins: 如果企业代码和公共代码差异不大、没有专有框架，直接用基座模型即可，微调的隐私与运维成本不划算。
options: 从零在企业代码上训练一个全新模型
在企业代码库上用同样的 FIM 目标微调基座 checkpoint，保留中间补全能力
把企业代码拼进公共基座的预训练里，混合训练一个共享模型
只在 prompt 里塞企业代码，不做任何微调
options_en: Train a brand-new model from scratch on the company's code.
Fine-tune the base checkpoint on the company's codebase with the same FIM objective, keeping mid-file completion.
Mix the company's code into the public base's pre-training to train one shared model.
Only stuff company code into the prompt, with no fine-tuning.
optionExplanations: 从零训练成本巨大且企业数据量远不够，丢掉了通用基座的知识。
对；微调基座 + 同一 FIM 目标，既学会专有框架/API/规范，又保住中间补全能力。
把企业专有码混进公共预训练会跨租户泄露 IP，违反隔离原则。
只靠 prompt 塞代码窗口有限、且每次都要现塞，学不到深层规范，不如微调稳。
optionExplanations_en: Training from scratch is hugely costly, the company's data is far too little, and it discards the general base's knowledge.
Correct — fine-tuning the base with the same FIM objective learns proprietary frameworks/APIs/conventions while keeping mid-file completion.
Mixing proprietary code into public pre-training leaks IP across tenants, violating isolation.
Prompt-only stuffing is window-limited and re-injected each time, learning no deep conventions — less robust than fine-tuning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在公共宽松语料上预训练好的通用模型权重，作为微调起点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A base checkpoint is the general model weights pre-trained on the public permissive corpus, used as the fine-tuning starting point.

scenario: 企业微调既要「越懂我们的代码越好」，又要「代码绝不能泄露」。
scenario_en: Enterprise fine-tuning wants both 'understand our code deeply' and 'our code must never leak.'
q: 企业微调的核心张力是什么，怎么落地约束？
q_en: What's the core tension in enterprise fine-tuning, and how is it constrained?
why: 张力是「个性化 vs IP 隐私」：越用企业代码微调越贴合，但代码是敏感 IP 不能外泄。落地约束是把整个微调流程关进客户安全边界——VPC 或 air-gapped——数据、训练、模型都不出边界，才能既个性化又不泄露。
why_en: The tension is personalization versus IP privacy, constrained by running the entire fine-tuning inside the customer's security boundary (VPC or air-gapped).
tradeoff: 个性化(用专有码微调更贴合) vs IP 隐私(专有码不能外泄)→ 微调全程在 VPC/air-gapped 内
options: 张力是精度 vs 延迟，靠量化解决
张力是个性化 vs IP 隐私，把微调全程关进客户 VPC/air-gapped 边界内解决
张力是模型大小 vs 成本，靠蒸馏解决
没有张力，企业代码可以随便拿去微调共享模型
options_en: The tension is accuracy vs latency, solved by quantization.
The tension is personalization vs IP privacy, solved by running fine-tuning entirely inside the customer's VPC/air-gapped boundary.
The tension is model size vs cost, solved by distillation.
There's no tension; company code can freely fine-tune a shared model.
optionExplanations: 精度 vs 延迟是服务侧取舍，不是企业微调的隐私张力。
对；个性化要用专有码、隐私要求专有码不外泄，把微调关进 VPC/air-gapped 边界正是解法。
大小 vs 成本是模型选择问题，与「专有码不能泄露」的张力无关。
随便拿企业码去微调共享模型会跨租户泄 IP，正是要避免的。
optionExplanations_en: Accuracy vs latency is a serving trade-off, not enterprise fine-tuning's privacy tension.
Correct — personalization needs proprietary code while privacy forbids leaking it, so confining fine-tuning to a VPC/air-gapped boundary is the fix.
Size vs cost is model selection, unrelated to the 'code must not leak' tension.
Freely fine-tuning a shared model on company code leaks IP across tenants — exactly what to avoid.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户在云上的隔离私有网络边界，微调可关在其中不外泄。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) is a customer's isolated private network boundary in the cloud where fine-tuning can run without egress.

scenario: 落地企业微调时要定几条设计决策，兼顾隐私、隔离与新鲜度。
scenario_en: Implementing enterprise fine-tuning requires several design decisions balancing privacy, isolation, and freshness.
q: 企业微调需要定哪些设计决策？(多选)
q_en: Which design decisions does enterprise fine-tuning require? (multiple)
why: 数据保留（训练完清除训练数据、临时存储加密）、模型隔离（每个客户的模型只服务该客户，绝不跨租户共享）、更新节奏（代码库演进模型会漂，多久重训一次，平衡新鲜度 vs 算力）。这三条共同守住隐私、隔离与时效。
why_en: Data retention (purge training data after the job, encrypt temp storage), model isolation (each customer's model serves only them), and update cadence (re-fine-tune frequency balancing freshness vs compute).
options: 数据保留：训练后清除训练数据、临时存储加密
模型隔离：每个客户的模型只服务该客户，不跨租户共享
更新节奏：代码库演进会漂，定期重训平衡新鲜度 vs 算力
把所有客户的微调模型合并成一个通用大模型对外提供
options_en: Data retention: purge training data after the job, encrypt temporary storage.
Model isolation: each customer's model serves only that customer, no cross-tenant sharing.
Update cadence: the codebase drifts, so re-train periodically to balance freshness vs compute.
Merge all customers' fine-tuned models into one general model served to everyone.
optionExplanations: 对；训练完就清数据、临时存储加密，最小化 IP 停留时间，是隐私底线。
对；一客户一模型、绝不跨租户共享，防止 A 的专有码经模型泄给 B。
对；代码库变了模型会过时，重训频率要在新鲜度与算力间权衡。
错；合并各客户模型对外提供，等于把各家专有知识混着泄露，严重违反隔离。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — purging data post-training and encrypting temp storage minimizes IP residency — a privacy floor.
Correct — one model per customer with no cross-tenant sharing prevents A's proprietary code leaking to B via the model.
Correct — as the codebase changes the model goes stale, so re-training cadence balances freshness against compute.
Wrong — merging customers' models and serving everyone mixes and leaks each firm's proprietary knowledge, badly violating isolation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个客户的微调模型只服务自己，不与其他租户共享，防 IP 交叉泄露。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model isolation means each customer's fine-tuned model serves only them, never shared across tenants, preventing IP cross-leakage.

scenario: 企业微调要用到专有代码，得判断它只能在哪些部署模式下开展。
scenario_en: Enterprise fine-tuning uses proprietary code, so you must judge which deployment modes allow it.
q: 企业微调只在哪些隐私模式下可行，为什么？
q_en: In which privacy modes is enterprise fine-tuning viable, and why?
why: 只在 telemetry-off 或 air-gapped 模式下可行：这两种模式保证专有代码不被外部保留/训练、或根本不出客户边界，才敢拿它做微调。telemetry-on 会外发甚至保留代码，用它微调等于把 IP 暴露，绝不允许。
why_en: Only telemetry-off or air-gapped, because they guarantee proprietary code isn't retained/trained externally or never leaves the boundary, whereas telemetry-on would expose the IP.
whenOtherWins: 如果客户只想用通用基座、不做任何专有码微调，telemetry-on 的默认个人模式就够，不触发微调的隐私门槛。
options: 只在 telemetry-on 模式，因为要把代码发出去才能训练
任何模式都行，微调与隐私无关
只在 telemetry-off 或 air-gapped 模式，保证专有码不外泄/不出边界才敢微调
只在完全公开的开源仓库上，不涉及隐私模式
options_en: Only telemetry-on, because code must be sent out to train.
Any mode — fine-tuning is unrelated to privacy.
Only telemetry-off or air-gapped, so proprietary code isn't leaked / doesn't leave the boundary.
Only on fully public open-source repos, with no privacy mode involved.
optionExplanations: telemetry-on 会外发/保留代码，拿专有码在这种模式微调恰恰泄 IP，不可行。
微调直接处理专有代码，与隐私强相关，绝非无关。
对；只有 off/air-gapped 保证专有码不被外部保留或不出边界，才是微调的安全前提。
企业微调正是要用专有(非公开)代码，说只在公开仓库就不是企业微调了。
optionExplanations_en: Telemetry-on egresses/retains code, so fine-tuning proprietary code there leaks IP — not viable.
Fine-tuning directly handles proprietary code and is strongly privacy-related, not unrelated.
Correct — only off/air-gapped guarantee proprietary code isn't externally retained or doesn't leave the boundary, the safe precondition for fine-tuning.
Enterprise fine-tuning specifically uses proprietary (non-public) code, so 'public repos only' isn't enterprise fine-tuning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两种保证代码不被外部保留/训练或不出客户边界的部署模式，是企业微调前提。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Telemetry-off and air-gapped are deployment modes ensuring code isn't externally retained/trained or never leaves the boundary, prerequisites for enterprise fine-tuning.

scenario: 微调后的模型可能背下了专有代码片段，若 checkpoint 处理不当，代码可能被反向套出。
scenario_en: A fine-tuned model may memorize proprietary snippets, and a mishandled checkpoint could let them be extracted.
q: 企业微调的 IP 泄露风险是什么，怎么缓解？
q_en: What's the IP-leak risk of enterprise fine-tuning, and how to mitigate?
why: 风险：微调模型记住了专有代码，加上 checkpoint 保管不当，专有代码可能经模型输出或 checkpoint 被套出。缓解：differential privacy（限制任一样本对输出的影响）或 membership inference testing（测某段代码是否被模型记住），把单条样本的可提取性压下去。
why_en: The risk is a fine-tuned model memorizing proprietary code plus a mishandled checkpoint leaking it, mitigated by differential privacy or membership inference testing to bound any single example's influence.
tradeoff: 更强个性化(记更多专有码但易被套出) vs 差分隐私(抗提取但个性化略弱)
options: 风险是模型太慢，缓解靠加卡
风险是模型记住专有码+checkpoint 处理不当致泄露；用差分隐私或成员推断测试缓解
风险是语料太小，缓解靠数据增强
微调后不存在任何 IP 泄露风险
options_en: The risk is a slow model, mitigated by adding GPUs.
The risk is the model memorizing proprietary code plus a mishandled checkpoint leaking it; mitigate with differential privacy or membership inference testing.
The risk is too small a corpus, mitigated by augmentation.
There's no IP-leak risk after fine-tuning.
optionExplanations: 速度是服务问题，与专有码被记住/套出的 IP 风险无关。
对；记忆 + checkpoint 失管是泄露路径，差分隐私限制单样本影响、成员推断测试查是否被记住，正是缓解手段。
语料小是质量问题，不是 IP 泄露风险，答非所问。
微调恰恰引入记忆专有码的泄露风险，说「不存在」是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Speed is a serving issue, unrelated to the IP risk of memorized/extractable proprietary code.
Correct — memorization plus a mishandled checkpoint is the leak path; differential privacy bounds per-sample influence and membership inference tests whether code was memorized — the mitigations.
A small corpus is a quality issue, not IP-leak risk — off point.
Fine-tuning specifically introduces memorization-leak risk, so 'no risk' is wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时限制任一单条样本对模型输出的影响，降低被反向提取的可能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Differential privacy bounds how much any single training example influences outputs, reducing extractability.

termDefinitions.term: membership inference testing / 成员推断测试
termDefinitions.meaning: 检测某段具体代码是否被模型记住(是否属训练集)的评估手段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Membership inference testing checks whether a specific piece of code was memorized (was in the training set).

q: 把代码语料构建流水线按正确顺序排好：
q_en: Order the code corpus construction pipeline correctly:
steps: 许可过滤：只留 MIT/Apache/BSD，剔除 copyleft
去重：MinHash 在文件+函数级删近似重复
质量过滤：去自动生成/坏语法/vendored 依赖
监控各语言语料规模，防小众语言被过滤到欠训练
why: 先许可过滤挡法律风险（缩水 40–60%），再 MinHash 去重防背样板码，然后质量过滤提信噪比，最后监控各语言规模防激进过滤误伤 Rust/Kotlin 等小众语言。合规→去冗余→提质量→守长尾，逐层收敛。
why_en: License filter first to block legal risk, then MinHash dedup to stop boilerplate memorization, then quality filter to raise signal, and finally monitor per-language size to guard rare languages.
diagram:
flowchart LR L["许可过滤
去 copyleft"] --> D["MinHash 去重"] D --> Q["质量过滤"] Q --> M["监控各语言规模"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 每道过滤后统计各编程语言剩余语料量，防长尾语言被砍空。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-language monitoring tracks each programming language's remaining corpus after every stage to prevent long-tail languages being emptied.
